airbnb.name: Airbnb
airbnb.description: Access detailed Airbnb listings, pricing, availability, reviews and more.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the location you want to search for on Airbnb. Optional when bounding_box is provided.

params.name: bounding_box
params.doc: This parameter is used to specify the bounding box for the search. The format is [[lat,long],[lat,long]]. The first coordinate is the top-right corner of the bounding box, and the second coordinate is the bottom-left corner of the bounding box. Optional when q is provided. If both are passed, the bounding_box parameter takes precedence, and q should be within the bounding box.

params.name: airbnb_domain
params.doc: This parameter defines the Airbnb domain to search on. Airbnb has multiple domains for different countries/regions and languages. Check the full list of supported Airbnb domains.

params.name: currency
params.doc: This parameter defines the currency for pricing information. Defaults to USD on airbnb.com; country-specific domains use their own local currency unless this parameter is set. Check the full list of supported currencies.

params.name: include_taxes
params.doc: Accepts true or false. When set to true, each property's price carries total_with_taxes and itemizes its tax lines in breakdown, with no extra per-property call. Applies to airbnb.com, where taxes normally appear only at checkout; other country-specific domains are unaffected (many, like EU domains, already show tax-inclusive totals by default). The nightly prices match the default response; taxes are itemized on top.

params.name: check_in_date
params.doc: Defines the check-in date for the Airbnb stay in the format YYYY-MM-DD. This date marks the beginning of the reservation. Can not be used together with time_period.

params.name: check_out_date
params.doc: The check-out date for the Airbnb stay in the format YYYY-MM-DD. This date marks the end of the reservation. Parameter check_in_date must also be provided when using the check_out_date parameter. Defaults to the day after check_in_date if not provided.

params.name: time_period
params.doc: This parameter restricts results to specific time periods in any given date. Can not be used together with check_in_date and check_out_date. Supported values are: weekend_trip - 2 nights on a weekend.

params.name: adults
params.doc: The number of adults (Ages 13 and above) staying at the Airbnb property. Up to 16 adults are allowed.Defaults to 1 if children, infants or pets are provided.

params.name: children
params.doc: The number of children (Ages 2-12) staying at the Airbnb property. Up to 15 children are allowed.

params.name: infants
params.doc: The number of infants (Ages under 2) staying at the Airbnb property. Up to 5 infants are allowed.

params.name: pets
params.doc: The number of pets staying at the Airbnb property. Up to 5 pets are allowed.

params.name: price_min
params.doc: This parameter controls the minimum price of the properties returned.

params.name: price_max
params.doc: This parameter controls the maximum price of the properties returned.

params.name: type_of_place
params.doc: This parameter controls the type of place you want to rent. Acceptable values are any, room or entire_home. Defaults to any.

params.name: property_types
params.doc: This parameter controls the type of property you want to rent. Acceptable values are house, guesthouse, apartment or hotel. Multiple values can be applied by separating them with commas (e.g., house,apartment).

params.name: bedrooms
params.doc: The number of bedrooms the Airbnb property has. Acceptable values are 0-8.

params.name: beds
params.doc: The number of beds the Airbnb property has. Acceptable values are 0-8.

params.name: bathrooms
params.doc: The number of bathrooms the Airbnb property has. Acceptable values are 0-8.

params.name: amenities
params.doc: This parameter allows you to filter properties by amenties they offer. Multiple amenties can be applied by separating them with commas (e.g., wifi,air_conditioning). Check the full list of amenities supported by Airbnb.

airbnb_experience_details.name: Airbnb Experience Details
airbnb_experience_details.description: Retrieve details, pricing, availability, reviews, and host info for Airbnb Experiences.

params.name: experience_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the ID of the Airbnb Experience you want to retrieve information for. This is the unique identifier for the experience on Airbnb and it can be found in the URL on https://www.airbnb.com/experiences/experience_id.

params.name: airbnb_domain
params.doc: This parameter defines the Airbnb domain to search on. Airbnb has multiple domains for different countries/regions and languages. Check the full list of supported Airbnb domains.

params.name: currency
params.doc: This parameter defines the currency for pricing information. Check the full list of supported currencies.

airbnb_experiences.name: Airbnb Experiences
airbnb_experiences.description: Search and access Airbnb experiences, activities, tours, and events worldwide with real-time pricing and availability.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the location you want to search for experiences on Airbnb (e.g., New York, Tokyo).

params.name: airbnb_domain
params.doc: This parameter defines the Airbnb domain to search on. Airbnb has multiple domains for different countries/regions and languages. Check the full list of supported Airbnb domains.

params.name: currency
params.doc: This parameter defines the currency for pricing information. Check the full list of supported currencies.

params.name: check_in_date
params.doc: Defines the check-in date in the format YYYY-MM-DD. Used to filter experiences available on specific dates.

params.name: check_out_date
params.doc: Defines the check-out date in the format YYYY-MM-DD. Parameter check_in_date must also be provided when using the check_out_date parameter.

params.name: adults
params.doc: The number of adults (Ages 13 and above) for the experience. Up to 16 adults are allowed.

params.name: children
params.doc: The number of children (Ages 2-12) for the experience. Up to 15 children are allowed.

params.name: infants
params.doc: The number of infants (Ages under 2) for the experience. Up to 5 infants are allowed.

params.name: price_min
params.doc: This parameter controls the minimum price of the experiences returned.

params.name: price_max
params.doc: This parameter controls the maximum price of the experiences returned.

params.name: experience_type
params.doc: This parameter filters experiences by type. Multiple types can be applied by separating them with commas (e.g., cooking,food_tours).Supported values are: architecture, art_workshops, beauty, cooking, cultural_tours, dining, flying, food_tours, galleries, landmarks, museums, outdoors, performances, shopping_and_fashion, tastings, water_sports, wellness, wildlife, workouts.

params.name: traveler_type
params.doc: This parameter filters experiences by traveler type. Multiple types can be applied by separating them with commas (e.g., solo,date_night). Supported values are: kids, big_groups, solo, date_night.

params.name: time_of_day
params.doc: This parameter filters experiences by time of day. Multiple values can be applied by separating them with commas (e.g., morning,afternoon). Supported values are: morning, afternoon, evening.

params.name: min_duration
params.doc: This parameter sets the minimum duration of experiences in minutes (e.g., 60 for at least 1 hour).

params.name: max_duration
params.doc: This parameter sets the maximum duration of experiences in minutes (e.g., 180 for up to 3 hours).

params.name: language_offered
params.doc: Filters experiences by the language they are offered in. Multiple languages can be applied by separating them with commas (e.g., english,spanish).Supported values are: english, french, german, japanese, italian, russian, spanish, chinese, arabic, hindi, portuguese, turkish, indonesian, dutch, korean, bengali, thai, punjabi, greek, sign_language, hebrew, polish, malay, tagalog, danish, swedish, norwegian, finnish, czech, hungarian, ukrainian.

params.name: next_page_token
params.doc: Fetches the next batch of experiences that Airbnb lazy-loads on scroll. Pass the next_page_token from the previous response. sections are only returned on the first page.

airbnb_property.name: Airbnb Property
airbnb_property.description: Access detailed Airbnb Property's details, pricing, availability, reviews, and more.

params.name: property_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the ID of the property you want to retrieve information for. This is the unique identifier for the property on Airbnb and it can be retrieved using the Airbnb Search API or in the URL on https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/property_id. Optional when booking_token is provided.

params.name: booking_token
params.doc: Parameter defines a booking token for the property you want to retrieve information for. This is token can be found in the Airbnb Search API and it contains the booking information (property ID, check-in, check-out, adults, children, infants, pets) retrieved in the search, so you don't need to repeat it in this API.

params.name: airbnb_domain
params.doc: This parameter defines the Airbnb domain to search on. Airbnb has multiple domains for different countries/regions and languages. Check the full list of supported Airbnb domains.

params.name: currency
params.doc: This parameter defines the currency for pricing information. Check the full list of supported currencies.

params.name: check_in_date
params.doc: Defines the check-in date for the Airbnb stay in the format YYYY-MM-DD. This date marks the beginning of the reservation. Can not be used together with time_period. If passed together with booking_token, it will override the check-in date set in the token.

params.name: check_out_date
params.doc: The check-out date for the Airbnb stay in the format YYYY-MM-DD. This date marks the end of the reservation. Parameter check_in_date must also be provided when using the check_out_date parameter. Defaults to the day after check_in_date if not provided. If passed together with booking_token, it will override the check-out date set in the token.

params.name: adults
params.doc: The number of adults (Ages 13 and above) staying at the Airbnb property. Up to 16 adults are allowed. Defaults to 1 if children, infants or pets are provided. If passed together with booking_token, it will override the number of adults set in the token.

params.name: children
params.doc: The number of children (Ages 2-12) staying at the Airbnb property. Up to 15 children are allowed. If passed together with booking_token, it will override the number of children set in the token.

params.name: infants
params.doc: The number of infants (Ages under 2) staying at the Airbnb property. Up to 5 infants are allowed. If passed together with booking_token, it will override the number of infants set in the token.

params.name: pets
params.doc: The number of pets staying at the Airbnb property. Up to 5 pets are allowed. If passed together with booking_token, it will override the number of pets set in the token.

airbnb_property_availability_calendar.name: Airbnb Property Availability Calendar
airbnb_property_availability_calendar.description: Access Airbnb property availability data day-by-day across up to 12 months — including bookable dates, check-in/out windows, and minimum stay constraints.

params.name: property_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the ID of the property you want to retrieve the availability calendar for. This is the unique identifier for the property on Airbnb and it can be retrieved using the Airbnb Search API or in the URL on https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/property_id.

params.name: start_month
params.doc: Parameter defines the starting month of the calendar window. Must be an integer between 1 and 12. Defaults to the current month.

params.name: start_year
params.doc: Parameter defines the starting year of the calendar window. Must be a 4 digit year. Defaults to the current year.

params.name: months
params.doc: Parameter defines the number of months to retrieve starting from start_month / start_year. Must be an integer between 1 and 12. Defaults to 12.

params.name: airbnb_domain
params.doc: This parameter defines the Airbnb domain to use. Airbnb has multiple domains for different countries/regions and languages. Check the full list of supported Airbnb domains.

airbnb_property_reviews.name: Airbnb Property Reviews
airbnb_property_reviews.description: Access detailed Airbnb property reviews data, their ratings, and more.

params.name: property_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the ID of the property you want to retrieve reviews for. This is the unique identifier for the property on Airbnb and it can be retrieved using the Airbnb Search API or in the URL on https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/property_id.

params.name: q
params.doc: Parameter defines the search query to filter reviews by. Reviews translated from another language will not appear, but you can search in the original language.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Parameter defines the sorting order of the reviews. Supported values are most_relevant, most_recent, highest_rating, lowest_rating. Default value is most_relevant.

params.name: airbnb_domain
params.doc: This parameter defines the Airbnb domain to search on and the language that will be used to translate the reviews. Airbnb has multiple domains for different countries/regions and languages. Check the full list of supported Airbnb domains.

params.name: page
params.doc: Parameter defines the page number to retrieve. Default value is 1.

amazon_bestsellers.name: Amazon Bestsellers
amazon_bestsellers.description: Retrieve Amazon bestseller rankings, new releases, movers and shakers, most wished for, and most gifted products with pricing, ratings, and reviews via API

params.name: bestseller_type
params.doc: Parameter defines the type of bestseller list to retrieve. Available values: bestsellers - default. Current top-selling products by sales volume.

params.name: category_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the Amazon category. It can be a category slug (e.g., kitchen, electronics, toys-and-games) or a numeric sub-category ID (e.g., 166835011). When omitted, returns the overall bestsellers across all departments. To find the category_id, navigate to any Amazon bestseller page (e.g., amazon.com/gp/bestsellers) and select a category from the sidebar. The category slug or numeric ID appears in the URL path — for example, kitchen from /gp/bestsellers/kitchen or 166835011 from /gp/new-releases/baby-products/166835011. You can also fetch valid category IDs programmatically via the Amazon Categories API. Use the ranking category_type that matches your bestseller_type (bestsellers, new_releases, movers_and_shakers, most_wished_for, or most_gifted) — the id field in that response can be used directly as category_id here.

params.name: amazon_domain
params.doc: The default parameter amazon.com defines the Amazon domain of the search. Check the full list of supported Amazon domains.

params.name: language
params.doc: The language parameter is used to specify the display language of Amazon page. Check the full list of supported Amazon display languages.

params.name: delivery_country
params.doc: A two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code that defines the country of the delivery address.By default, it is set to the country code of the selected Amazon domain (e.g. de for amazon.de). Check the full list of supported Amazon delivery countries.

params.name: page
params.doc: The parameter determines the results page number. Amazon bestseller pages have a maximum of 2 pages per category (50 items per page, 100 items total). Pagination is not available for root pages without a category_id.

amazon_categories.name: Amazon Categories
amazon_categories.description: Browse Amazon's full category hierarchy. List root categories, drill into subcategories, look up nodes, or search by name across all category types.

params.name: category_type
params.doc: The type of category tree to browse:standard - default. Browse node categories used for product search.

params.name: category_id
params.doc: The Amazon browse node ID of a specific category. Returns the category, its parent context, and direct children. Cannot be used together with q.

params.name: q
params.doc: A text query to search categories by name. Cannot be used together with category_id.

params.name: amazon_domain
params.doc: The Amazon domain to browse categories for. Check the full list of supported Amazon domains.

amazon_offers.name: Amazon Offers
amazon_offers.description: Access real-time Amazon product's offers and filter them by various criteria.

params.name: asin
params.doc: The asin parameter is used to specify the product you want to retrieve offers for. It accepts an Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN), a unique identifier for products on Amazon.

params.name: amazon_domain
params.doc: The default parameter amazon.com defines the Amazon domain of the search. Check the full list of supported Amazon domains.

params.name: postal_code
params.doc: Postal code for the delivery location. Use this for postal-code countries (e.g. 10001 for US, SW1A 0AA for UK, M5V 2T6 for CA). Check the list of supported Amazon postal codes by domain and format. The response reports the outcome in search_metadata.delivery_location: applied, not_applied, or unverified.

params.name: delivery_city
params.doc: City for the delivery address in snake_case (e.g. delivery_city=riyadh). Only supported for city-based countries (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt). For other countries use postal_code. See the full list of supported Amazon delivery cities and areas by domain.

params.name: delivery_area
params.doc: Area within the city, only available for amazon.ae (e.g. business_bay). Optional and must be sent with delivery_city. See the full list of supported Amazon delivery areas

params.name: delivery_country
params.doc: A two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code that defines the country of the delivery address.By default, it is set to the country code of the selected Amazon domain (e.g. de for amazon.de), you can also explicitly set it to a different country. Check the full list of supported Amazon delivery countries.

params.name: filters
params.doc: This parameter allows you to filter search results by various criteria. Multiple filters can be applied by separating them with commas (e.g., prime,new,used_very_good). Available filters include: Condition filters: new

params.name: page
params.doc: This parameter determines the results page number. It defaults to 1.

amazon_product.name: Amazon Product
amazon_product.description: Use the Amazon Product Scraper API to scrape product details, prices, delivery information, ratings, reviews and more.

params.name: asin
params.doc: The asin parameter is used to specify the product you want to retrieve details for. It accepts an Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN), a unique identifier for products on Amazon.

params.name: amazon_domain
params.doc: The default parameter amazon.com defines the Amazon domain of the search. Check the full list of supported Amazon domains.

params.name: language
params.doc: The language parameter is used to specify the display language of Amazon page. Check the full list of supported Amazon display languages.

params.name: postal_code
params.doc: Postal code for the delivery location. Use this for postal-code countries (e.g. 10001 for US, SW1A 0AA for UK, M5V 2T6 for CA). Check the list of supported Amazon postal codes by domain and format. The response reports the outcome in search_metadata.delivery_location: applied, not_applied, or unverified.

params.name: delivery_city
params.doc: City for the delivery address in snake_case (e.g. delivery_city=riyadh). Only supported for city-based countries (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt). For other countries use postal_code. See the full list of supported Amazon delivery cities and areas by domain.

params.name: delivery_area
params.doc: Area within the city, only available for amazon.ae (e.g. business_bay). Optional and must be sent with delivery_city. See the full list of supported Amazon delivery areas

params.name: delivery_country
params.doc: A two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code that defines the country of the delivery address.By default, it is set to the country code of the selected Amazon domain (e.g. de for amazon.de), you can also explicitly set it to a different country. Check the full list of supported Amazon delivery countries.

params.name: variant_prices
params.doc: Set this parameter to true to include the price of each product variant. Enabling it may increase the response time. Some products include variant prices by default, even without this parameter.

amazon_search.name: Amazon Search
amazon_search.description: Access detailed Amazon products data, reviews, prices, badges and more. Elevate your e-commerce apps with direct queries.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the terms you want to search on Amazon.

params.name: amazon_domain
params.doc: The default parameter amazon.com defines the Amazon domain of the search. Check the full list of supported Amazon domains.

params.name: language
params.doc: The language parameter is used to specify the display language of Amazon page. Check the full list of supported Amazon display languages.

params.name: postal_code
params.doc: Postal code for the delivery location. Use this for postal-code countries (e.g. 10001 for US, SW1A 0AA for UK, M5V 2T6 for CA). Check the list of supported Amazon postal codes by domain and format. The response reports the outcome in search_metadata.delivery_location: applied, not_applied, or unverified.

params.name: delivery_city
params.doc: City for the delivery address in snake_case (e.g. delivery_city=riyadh). Only supported for city-based countries (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt). For other countries use postal_code. See the full list of supported Amazon delivery cities and areas by domain.

params.name: delivery_area
params.doc: Area within the city, only available for amazon.ae (e.g. business_bay). Optional and must be sent with delivery_city. See the full list of supported Amazon delivery areas

params.name: delivery_country
params.doc: A two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code that defines the country of the delivery address.By default, it is set to the country code of the selected Amazon domain (e.g. de for amazon.de), you can also explicitly set it to a different country. Check the full list of supported Amazon delivery countries.

params.name: category_id
params.doc: An Amazon browse node ID that limits results to a specific category. Use the Amazon Categories API to discover valid category IDs for any domain.

params.name: rh
params.doc: This parameter filters search results based on specific criteria such as brand and ratings. You can find rh values either by calling the Amazon Search API or directly from an Amazon URL. For example, to filter items rated 4 stars and above and within a specific price range, separate the values with a comma , and use the parameter like this: rh=p_72:2661618011,p_36:2661612011. Here’s how it might look in a URL: https://www.amazon.com/s?k=electronics&rh=p_72:2661618011,p_36:2661612011.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Parameter allows sorting search results by different criteria. Below is the list of available sorting options: featured - default sort order.

params.name: price_min
params.doc: This parameter controls the minimum price of the products returned. For instance - 10 value would return products with a minimum price of 10.

params.name: price_max
params.doc: This parameter controls the maximum price of the products returned. For instance - 20.5 value would return products with a maximum price of 20.5.

params.name: page
params.doc: The parameter determines the results page number. It defaults to 1.

apple_app_store.name: Apple App Store
apple_app_store.description: Get Apple App Store app details like ID, versions, screenshots, title, price, ratings, and more in localized JSON format.

params.name: term
params.doc: Parameter defines the app query you want to search.

params.name: country
params.doc: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), defines the country of the store. The default parameter is us. Check the full list of supported Apple App Store countries.

params.name: lang
params.doc: Defines the language of the store. The default parameter is en-us. Check the full list of supported Apple App Store languages.

params.name: device
params.doc: Filters apps based on the device they are available for in the App Store. The default is mobile. Other available options are: desktop for Mac apps

params.name: property
params.doc: When used, it shows only apps made by the developer specified in the term parameter. The only available option is developer.

params.name: include_explicit
params.doc: A boolean indicating whether or not you want to include explicit content in your search results. The default is true.

params.name: num
params.doc: Specifies the number of results to return. By default, it is set to 10. The maximum number of results is 200.

apple_app_store_top_charts.name: Apple App Store Top Charts
apple_app_store_top_charts.description: Scrape Apple App Store top charts. Filter by category, chart or device. Get titles, developer info, prices, ratings, and more in JSON format.

params.name: category
params.doc: Filters the top charts by category in the App Store. Default is all. Check the full list of supported Apple App Store categories.

params.name: store_device
params.doc: Shows the chart for the specified device in the App Store. Available options are: iphone Default

params.name: chart
params.doc: Shows the chart for the specified device in the App Store. Available options are: top_free Default

params.name: country
params.doc: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), defines the country of the store. The default parameter is us. Check the full list of supported Apple App Store countries.

apple_app_store_top_grossing.name: Apple App Store Top Grossing Apps
apple_app_store_top_grossing.description: Retrieve top-grossing Apple App Store apps by country and category, with rankings, app details, developer data, and pricing in JSON.

params.name: category
params.doc: Filters apps by App Store category. The default is all. See Apple App Store categories and engine availability.

params.name: store_device
params.doc: Selects which device chart to rank. Available options are iphone, ipad, and appletv. The default is iphone.

params.name: country
params.doc: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) for the App Store storefront. The default is us. Check the full list of supported Apple App Store countries.

params.name: num
params.doc: Number of apps to return. By default, it is set to 50. It must be between 1 and 100.

apple_maps.name: Apple Maps
apple_maps.description: Get Apple Maps local search results like business names, addresses, phone numbers, ratings, hours, and coordinates in JSON format.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the terms you want to search on Apple Maps. Queries can include terms like "restaurants near me" or "Starbucks New York".

params.name: location
params.doc: Defines the search origin by name. The location is resolved to GPS coordinates using the locations API (e.g. Manhattan, New York, United States). See the full list of supported locations. center and location can't be used together. When neither is provided, the search covers the whole world.

params.name: center
params.doc: Defines the coordinates of the center point of the region to search within, in the latitude,longitude format (e.g. 40.712776,-74.005974 for New York, NY). center and location can't be used together. When neither is provided, the search covers the whole world.

params.name: zoom
params.doc: Defines how zoomed in the search region is, as an integer from 1 (widest area) to 20 (street level). Higher values search a smaller, more local area. When omitted, the default span applies.

params.name: span
params.doc: Defines the exact size of the search area as two values in degrees: its north-south size, then its east-west size (e.g. 0.1,0.15 searches an area 0.1° tall and 0.15° wide). Both values must be greater than 0, with the north-south size up to 180 and the east-west size up to 360. Use this instead of zoom when you need precise control or a non-square area. If both span and zoom are provided, span is used. Defaults to 0.35,0.35 (a local area) when a center or location is set, or 180,360 (the whole world) when there is no anchor.

params.name: filters
params.doc: Refines results using the filters available for a search. Pass a comma-separated list of values taken from the filters array of a previous response (e.g. OPEN_NOW,PRICE_RANGE_INEXPENSIVE). Treat the values as opaque tokens and pass them back exactly as returned.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Defines the sort order. One of distance (nearest first), ratings (highest rated first), or best_match (Apple's default ranking). Defaults to best_match.

params.name: open_at
params.doc: Limits results to places open at a specific time. Accepts a time of day for today (18:00), a datetime (2026-06-04T18:00:00), or a datetime with a UTC offset (2026-06-04T18:00:00-05:00 or 2026-06-04T18:00:00Z). A time of day or offset-less datetime is interpreted in the timezone of the searched area; an explicit offset takes precedence. The resolved time must be in the future and no more than 24 hours from now.

params.name: lang
params.doc: Defines the interface language of the search. Check the full list of supported lang values. Defaults to en.

params.name: country
params.doc: Parameter defines the country where the search is coming from. Apple uses it to localize region-specific content, such as rating providers and formats. Check the full list of supported country values. Defaults to us.

apple_maps_guides.name: Apple Maps Guides
apple_maps_guides.description: Fetch an Apple Maps editorial guide by guide_id: title, description, publisher, cover photos, and every member place with full details in JSON.

params.name: guide_id
params.doc: The numeric identifier of the guide to fetch, returned as guide_id in the guide_results of the Apple Maps API (e.g. 15492827070352335266). It also appears as the curated query parameter of maps.apple.com/guides URLs.

params.name: lang
params.doc: Defines the language the guide and place details are returned in. Check the full list of supported lang values. Defaults to en.

params.name: country
params.doc: Parameter defines the country where the request is coming from. Apple uses it to localize region-specific content, such as rating providers and formats. Check the full list of supported country values. Defaults to us.

apple_maps_places.name: Apple Maps Places
apple_maps_places.description: Look up full Apple Maps place details by place_id in one request: title, category, address, phone, website, ratings, hours, and coordinates in JSON.

params.name: place_ids
params.doc: A comma-separated list of up to 20 Apple Maps place identifiers to look up in a single request. Each value is a place_id returned by the Apple Maps API — the same identifier used in maps.apple.com place URLs, so you can also copy it from the place-id query parameter of any Apple Maps link (e.g. ID14FABEE6C8FC5A,IBB4C75E7EBE40E08). Identifiers that Apple can't resolve are echoed back in not_found_places, so place_results may contain fewer places than requested.

params.name: lang
params.doc: Defines the language the place details are returned in. Check the full list of supported lang values. Defaults to en.

params.name: country
params.doc: Parameter defines the country where the request is coming from. Check the full list of supported country values. Defaults to us.

apple_product.name: Apple App Store Details
apple_product.description: Scrape iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple TV apps and games. Retrieve detailed app data in JSON format.

params.name: product_id
params.doc: The parameter defines the ID of the product you want to search for. For example, to find the product ID of TikTok, you would need to look at the URL path of its App Store page (e.g., https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tiktok/id835599320). In this case, the product ID is the number that follows /id in the URL, which is 835599320.

params.name: country
params.doc: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), defines the country and language of the store. The default parameter is us. Check the full list of supported Apple App Store countries.

apple_product_reviews.name: Apple App Store Reviews
apple_product_reviews.description: Scrape Apple App Store reviews in real-time. Get titles, texts, reviewer info, and more in localized JSON for iPhone and Mac apps.

params.name: product_id
params.doc: The parameter defines the ID of the product you want to search for. For example, to find the product_id of TikTok, you would need to look in the URL path of its App Store page (e.g., https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tiktok/id835599320). In this case, the product_id is the number that follows /id in the URL, which is 835599320.

params.name: country
params.doc: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), defines the country or region for which the reviews will be displayed. The default value is us. Check the full list of supported Apple App Store countries and regions.

params.name: page
params.doc: Specifies the page number of the results. By default, it is set to 1, maximum is 10. Number of results is fixed to 50 results per page.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Sorts the reviews based on various criteria. The default is most_recent. Available options are: most_recent – displays the latest reviews first.

autoscout24.name: AutoScout24
autoscout24.description: Search AutoScout24 car listings across Europe with structured filters: price, mileage, registration, fuel, and more.

params.name: make
params.doc: The vehicle make (brand), e.g. volkswagen, bmw, mercedes-benz. Names are lower-cased and hyphenated into the AutoScout24 path. The full list of valid makes is returned in the filters block of any response.

params.name: model
params.doc: The vehicle model, e.g. golf, 3-series. Requires make to be set.

params.name: price_min
params.doc: Minimum price, in the marketplace currency (EUR).

params.name: price_max
params.doc: Maximum price, in the marketplace currency (EUR).

params.name: mileage_min
params.doc: Minimum mileage in kilometres.

params.name: mileage_max
params.doc: Maximum mileage in kilometres.

params.name: registration_year_min
params.doc: Earliest first-registration year, between 1900 and 2100, e.g. 2018.

params.name: registration_year_max
params.doc: Latest first-registration year, between 1900 and 2100, e.g. 2022.

params.name: power_min
params.doc: Minimum engine power, in the unit set by power_unit.

params.name: power_max
params.doc: Maximum engine power, in the unit set by power_unit.

params.name: power_unit
params.doc: Unit power_min and power_max are given in. One of kw or hp. AutoScout24 filters in kW, so hp values are converted before the search runs.

params.name: fuel_type
params.doc: Fuel type. One of petrol, diesel, electric, hybrid_petrol, hybrid_diesel, cng, hydrogen, lpg, ethanol, other.

params.name: transmission
params.doc: Transmission. One of automatic, manual, semi_automatic.

params.name: body_type
params.doc: Body type. One of compact, convertible, coupe, suv, station_wagon, sedan, van, transporter, other.

params.name: seller_type
params.doc: Seller type. One of dealer, private.

params.name: condition
params.doc: Vehicle condition. One of new, used, annual, classic, demo, day_registration. Omit for every offer type. Accident vehicles are selected with damage.

params.name: damage
params.doc: How damaged and accident vehicles are treated. One of exclude, include, only. AutoScout24 hides them by default, so use include to search all cars and only to search damaged cars alone. On de, only selects currently damaged cars and results carry is_damaged. On the other marketplaces it selects cars with an accident history instead, so results carry condition: accident and can come back without is_damaged set.

params.name: zip
params.doc: Postal code to search around. Letters, digits, spaces and hyphens, up to 10 characters. Works on its own, in which case AutoScout24 applies its own default radius.

params.name: radius
params.doc: Search radius in kilometres around zip. Requires zip.

params.name: country
params.doc: The AutoScout24 marketplace to search. One of de, at, be, es, fr, it, lu, nl. Determines the domain, currency, and inventory.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Result ordering. One of best_match, price_asc, price_desc, mileage_asc, mileage_desc, registration_asc, registration_desc, power_asc, power_desc, newest.

params.name: page
params.doc: Page number (20 results per page). AutoScout24 caps browsing at 200 pages (4,000 results) per query. Narrow with filters to reach deeper inventory.

autoscout24_listing.name: AutoScout24 Listing
autoscout24_listing.description: Fetch the full detail sheet for a single AutoScout24 car listing: full spec, CO2 and emissions, equipment, seller, and location.

params.name: url
params.doc: The AutoScout24 listing to fetch. Pass the link returned by the AutoScout24 API (an organic_results[].link), a full offer URL, an offer path (/angebote/{slug} on de and at, /aanbod/{slug} on nl, /nl/aanbod/{slug} on be, and so on), the bare offer slug, which is resolved on the country market's own path, or a /smyle/details/{id}/ link from AutoScout24's own online checkout.Example: https://www.autoscout24.de/angebote/volkswagen-golf-vii-lim-automatik-acc-navi-sitzhz-diesel-schwarz-cat_ma74mo2084-42819366-1304-4bde-8224-50e79b8168e5

params.name: country
params.doc: The AutoScout24 marketplace to use when url is a path or bare slug. One of de, at, be, es, fr, it, lu, nl. When url is a full URL, its domain wins.

baidu.name: Baidu Search
baidu.description: Retrieve organic results, ads, top searches, and even more results in JSON format through the Baidu Search API.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the terms you want to search on Baidu. Queries can include operators and advanced filters like "machine learning models", site:, intitle:, or filetype:.

params.name: ct
params.doc: This parameter controls the language of search results. There are three options: 0 - Simplified and Traditional Chinese. (Default)

params.name: gpc
params.doc: Defines the specific time period for search results using Unix Timestamps. The parameter format should be stf=START_TIME,END_TIME|stftype=1, where START_TIME and END_TIME are Unix Timestamps marking the start and end of the desired timeframe. For example, using stf=1683108267,1714730667|stftype=1 would limit results to those within a year.

params.name: num
params.doc: This parameter specifies the number of results to display per page. Maximum number - 50. Use in combination with the page parameter to implement pagination functionality.

params.name: page
params.doc: This parameter indicates which page of results to return. By default, it is set to 1. Use in combination with the num parameter to implement pagination.

bestbuy_product.name: BestBuy Product
bestbuy_product.description: Retrieve detailed BestBuy product data including pricing, specifications, reviews, images, and open-box options by SKU.

params.name: product_id
params.doc: This parameter specifies the BestBuy product SKU (a numeric identifier). You can use the product_id field from our BestBuy Search API response, or find it in the URL of any BestBuy product page. Example: https://www.bestbuy.com/site/-/6667474.p?skuId=6667474 where 6667474 is the SKU.

bestbuy_search.name: BestBuy Search
bestbuy_search.description: Access detailed BestBuy product data, prices, ratings, and more. Retrieve real-time BestBuy search results in JSON format.

params.name: q
params.doc: The parameter specifies your search query. It accepts any term or phrase you'd typically input in a BestBuy search.

params.name: category_id
params.doc: This parameter filters search results to a specific BestBuy category. You can find the list of categories and their IDs in the filters section of the response. Another way is to search on BestBuy and apply a department filter — the category ID will appear in the URL as the id parameter.

params.name: filters
params.doc: Apply facet filters to narrow results. Use the filter_value from the filters section of the response. Combine multiple filters with ,. Example: brand_facet=Brand~HP,condition_facet=Condition~New.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Parameter allows sorting search results by different criteria. Below is the list of available sorting options: best_match - sort order based on relevance. Default

params.name: page
params.doc: The parameter determines the results page number. It defaults to 1. You can find the max page number in the pagination section of the response.

bing.name: Bing Search
bing.description: Localize your search to any geographic location. Scrape organic results, ads, related searches, questions and more.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the terms you want to search on Bing. Queries can include operators and advanced filters like "machine learning models", site:, feed:, AND, or OR.

params.name: device
params.doc: The default parameter desktop defines the search on a desktop device. The mobile parameter defines the search on a mobile device.

params.name: location
params.doc: This parameter is used to specify the canonical location of the search. For exact targeting or to see all available options, check out the Locations API. If multiple locations match your input, the most popular one will be selected. For example - location=New York would select New York,United States or location=London would select London TV Region,England,United Kingdom.

params.name: market_code
params.doc: Defines the country for search results. Format is language-country, like en-US. For a list of market values, check the full list of supported Bing market_code codes. Note: the market_code parameter can't be used together with country_code parameter.

params.name: lat
params.doc: Parameter defines the latitude of the location you want to use for the search.

params.name: lon
params.doc: Parameter defines the longitude of the location you want to use for the search.

params.name: country_code
params.doc: Specifies the country for the search results if market_code is not specified. Defaults to US if unspecified or market_code is not used. Check the full list of supported Bing coutry_code countries. Note: the country_code parameter can't be used together with market_code parameter.

params.name: language
params.doc: Sets the language for user interface text. Use 2-letter (ISO 639-1) or 4-letter codes ('-'). Defaults to en (English) if unspecified or unsupported. Check the full list of supported Bing language languages.

params.name: safe_search
params.doc: This parameter toggles the safe_search feature for the results. Default is Moderate. safe_search operates by filtering out adult content from your search results. Options are: off - returns results with adult text, images, and videos

params.name: time_period
params.doc: This parameter restricts results to URLs based on date. Supported values are: last_day - data from the past 24 hours.

params.name: time_period_min
params.doc: This parameter specifies the start of the time period. It could be used in combination with the time_period_max parameter. The value should be in the format MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: time_period_max
params.doc: This parameter specifies the end of the time period. It could be used in combination with the time_period_min parameter. The value should be in the format MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: filters
params.doc: This parameter allows to use various filters to restrict search results. It supports a wide range of filtering options, including date-based: ex1%3a"ez1" - data from the past 24 hours.

params.name: num
params.doc: This parameter specifies the number of results to display per page. Maximum number - 50. Use in combination with the page parameter to implement pagination functionality.

params.name: page
params.doc: This parameter indicates which page of results to return. By default, it is set to 1. Use in combination with the num parameter to implement pagination.

bing_copilot.name: Bing Copilot
bing_copilot.description: Access Bing Copilot's AI-generated search answers with structured data, markdown formatting, and reference links using the Bing Copilot API.

params.name: q
params.doc: Parameter defines the Bing Copilot search query.

bing_images.name: Bing Images
bing_images.description: Scrape images searching with the Bing Images API. Discover images from global sources, curated based on your query

params.name: q

params.name: market_code

params.name: language

params.name: safe_search

params.name: size

params.name: min_size

params.name: time_period

params.name: color
params.doc: This parameter controls the color of your search results. These options are available: black_and_white, color, red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, brown, black, gray,white.

params.name: image_type
params.doc: This parameter controls the type of your search results. There are only few options that are available: photo, gif, clipart, line_drawing, transparent, face and head_and_shoulders.

params.name: usage_rights
params.doc: This parameter controls the usage rights of your search results. Options that are available: public_domain, creative_commons_licenses, free_to_share_and_use, free_to_share_and_use_commercial, free_to_modify_share_and_use, free_to_modify_share_and_use_commercial.

params.name: aspect_ratio

params.name: page

bing_news.name: Bing News
bing_news.description: Scrape real-time news articles from various sources using the Bing News API. Retrieve organic results, trending topics, and more.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the terms you want to search on Bing News. Queries can include operators and advanced filters like "climate change", site:, inurl:, or intitle:. Note: Optional when category parameter is used. If both are provided, category takes priority.

params.name: category

Most categories can be found in Bing News official documentation.

params.name: device

params.name: market_code

params.name: num

bing_product.name: Bing Product

params.name: product_token
params.doc: Token that identifies a Bing Shopping product. Obtained from the shopping_results[].product_token field of a Bing Shopping API response. Carries the query and Bing product filters needed to reach the product page; treat it as opaque and pass it back unchanged.Note: tokens are ephemeral. They encode Bing's internal offer identifiers, which rotate as merchants add and remove listings, so fetch a fresh token from Bing Shopping immediately before each call rather than caching long-term.

params.name: market_code

params.name: country_code

params.name: language

params.name: market_code

params.name: country_code

params.name: language

params.name: sort_by

params.name: filters

params.name: page

bing_videos.name: Bing Videos
bing_videos.description: Scrape videos with the Bing Videos API. Discover videos from global sources, curated based on your query

params.name: market_code

params.name: duration

params.name: quality
