naver.name: Naver Search
naver.description: Scrape Naver for organic results, ads, images, videos, knowledge graph and more. Retrieve detailed app data in JSON format.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the terms you want to search on Naver. Queries can include terms like "Recipes" or "Seoul weather".

params.name: time_period
params.doc: Allows you to restrict your search to a specific time range. It can be one of the following predefined options: any_time past_hour past_day past_week past_month past_3_months past_6_months past_year Alternatively, you can specify a custom date range using the format DD.MM.YY..DD.MM.YY.

params.name: page
params.doc: Specifies the page number for pagination. The first page returns approximately 5 organic results along with other types of results, while each subsequent page contains 15 organic results only.Note: Maximum of 10 pages can be retrieved.

perplexity.name: Perplexity
perplexity.description: Access Perplexity AI answers in structured JSON—text blocks, markdown, and cited reference links.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the terms you want to ask Perplexity. The answer is returned in the same language as your query - for example, queries in German will receive answers in German, queries in Spanish will receive answers in Spanish.

params.name: sources
params.doc: Comma-separated list of source connectors Perplexity searches. Defaults to web. Supported values are: web - General web results.

reddit_ad_library.name: Reddit Ad Library
reddit_ad_library.description: Access detailed Reddit Ad Library data.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the terms you want to search within Reddit ad content. Queries can include terms like "gaming" or "fitness products". If not provided, all ads will be retrieved based on the applied filters.

params.name: industry
params.doc: Filters ads by industry category. Multiple values can be provided separated by commas. Allowed values: EDUCATION, TECH_B2C, TECH_B2B, RETAIL_AND_ECOMMERCE, ENTERTAINMENT, GAMING, FINANCIAL_SERVICES, HEALTH_AND_BEAUTY, CONSUMER_PACKAGED_GOODS, EMPLOYMENT, AUTO, TRAVEL, REAL_ESTATE, GAMBLING_AND_FANTASY_SPORTS, POLITICS_AND_GOVERNMENT, OTHER

params.name: budget_category
params.doc: Filters ads by budget category. Multiple values can be provided separated by commas. Allowed values: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH

params.name: post_type
params.doc: Filters ads by post type. Multiple values can be provided separated by commas. Allowed values: VIDEO, IMAGE, CAROUSEL, FREE_FORM

params.name: placements
params.doc: Filters ads by placement location. Multiple values can be provided separated by commas. Allowed values: COMMENTS_PAGE, FEED

params.name: objective_type
params.doc: Filters ads by objective type. Multiple values can be provided separated by commas. Allowed values: CLICKS, IMPRESSIONS, CONVERSIONS, VIDEO_VIEWABLE_IMPRESSIONS, APP_INSTALLS

shein_product.name: Shein Product Details
shein_product.description: Retrieve detailed information about specific Shein product, including pricing, images, descriptions, and variants via the Shein Product Details API.

params.name: product_id
params.doc: The parameter specifies the product ID of the Shein product you want to retrieve.

params.name: shein_domain
params.doc: The default parameter us.shein.com defines the Shein domain for the product. Check the full list of supported Shein domains.

params.name: language
params.doc: The language parameter is used to specify the display language of Shein page. Check the full list of supported Shein languages.

params.name: currency
params.doc: Parameter allows to get product prices for search results in the given currency. Check the full list of supported Shein currencies.

shein_search.name: Shein Search
shein_search.description: Retrieve Shein search results with pricing information and more. Access product data directly via API queries.

params.name: q
params.doc: The parameter specifies your search query. It accepts any term or phrase you'd typically input in Shein search. Must be at least 2 characters.

params.name: shein_domain
params.doc: The default parameter us.shein.com defines the Shein domain of the search. Check the full list of supported Shein domains.

params.name: language
params.doc: The language parameter is used to specify the display language of Shein page. Check the full list of supported Shein languages.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Parameter allows sorting search results by different criteria. Below is the list of available sorting options: recommended Default

params.name: category_id
params.doc: Parameter allows to search products by a category id. The value of category id can be found in JSON response, under shopping_results.category. path.

params.name: attribute_ids
params.doc: Parameter allows to search and filter products based on attribute IDs. The possible attribute_ids can be found in the subattributes array of each attribute object inside the filters.attributes array. Each sub-attribute object contains an attribute_id field, which is the attribute ID you can use here. The format for attribute_ids is 'int_int', for example: 101_725. If you want to specify multiple attribute IDs, separate them with hyphens, For example: 101_725-102_826.

params.name: currency
params.doc: Parameter allows to get product prices for search results in the given currency. Check the full list of supported Shein currencies.

params.name: price_min
params.doc: This parameter controls the minimum price of the products returned. For instance - 10 value would return products with a minimum price of 10.

params.name: price_max
params.doc: This parameter controls the maximum price of the products returned. For instance - 20.5 value would return products with a maximum price of 20.5.

params.name: page
params.doc: The parameter determines the results page number. It defaults to 1.

tiktok_ads_library.name: TikTok Ads Library
tiktok_ads_library.description: Access TikTok Ads Library data via API. Query TikTok ads with structured JSON responses.

params.name: q
params.doc: Defines the keyword for your search. Use this parameter to search for ads containing specific keywords or phrases. If you want to search for exact match, use "" to enclose the keyword.

params.name: advertiser_token
params.doc: Filters ads by an advertiser. A token that bundles an advertiser's ID and name in a single parameter. Can be found in the response of this API, the TikTok Ads Library Advertiser Search API and the TikTok Ads Library Ad Details API. Recommended over advertiser_id, since the TikTok Ads Library needs both the ID and the name to filter ads correctly.

params.name: advertiser_id
params.doc: Filters ads by an advertiser. Must be passed alongside the advertiser's name via the q parameter, otherwise the TikTok Ads Library returns unrelated ads. Prefer advertiser_token, which bundles both into one parameter. Can be found in the response of this API, the TikTok Ads Library Advertiser Search API and the TikTok Ads Library Ad Details API.

params.name: country
params.doc: Specifies the country for your search. The default value is ALL. Check the full list of supported TikTok Ads Library countries.

params.name: time_period
params.doc: Specifies the date range for ads. Use the format YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD to define a custom date range. If not specified, defaults to the last year from the current date.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Specifies the sorting order for ads. Supported values: last_shown_date_newest_to_oldest

params.name: next_page_token
params.doc: A token for fetching the next set of results. You can obtain this token from the next_page_token field in the previous response

tiktok_ads_library_ad_details.name: TikTok Ads Library Ad Details
tiktok_ads_library_ad_details.description: Retrieve details for a single TikTok Ad: advertiser, landing page link, call to action, targeting, audience size, creative assets, and impressions in JSON.

params.name: ad_id
params.doc: The unique identifier of the TikTok Ad. You can obtain this from the TikTok Ads Library API results (the id field of each ad).

tiktok_ads_library_advertiser_search.name: TikTok Ads Library Advertiser Search
tiktok_ads_library_advertiser_search.description: Search TikTok advertisers via API. Find advertiser IDs from TikTok's ad transparency database with structured JSON responses.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the advertiser name you want to search for in TikTok's ad library. Queries can include terms like "Nike" or "Coca Cola".

tiktok_profile.name: TikTok Profile
tiktok_profile.description: Get TikTok Profile data via API. Access follower counts, verification status, bio, post metrics, and engagement statistics for any account.

params.name: username
params.doc: Parameter defines the TikTok username or ID you want to retrieve profile information for. You can use the username with or without the @ symbol, or use the numeric TikTok ID directly. For example, @therock, therock, @6745191554350760966, and 6745191554350760966 will all retrieve the same profile.

tiktok_profile_videos.name: TikTok Profile Videos
tiktok_profile_videos.description: Get a TikTok profile's video feed via API. Retrieve captions, views, likes, comments, hashtags, thumbnail and more.

params.name: username
params.doc: Parameter defines the TikTok username you want to retrieve videos for. You can use the username with or without the @ symbol. For example, @therock and therock will both retrieve the same creator's feed.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Parameter defines the order of the returned videos. It can be set to latest (default), popular, or oldest.

params.name: next_page_token
params.doc: Parameter defines the token used to retrieve the next page of videos. It is returned as pagination.next_page_token when more videos are available.

tiktok_search.name: TikTok Search
tiktok_search.description: Search TikTok by keyword via API. Retrieve matching profiles, videos, and photos with captions, engagement counts, sounds, thumbnails, and more.

params.name: q
params.doc: Parameter defines the keyword you want to search TikTok for. It can be up to 100 characters. For example, messi returns profiles, videos, and photos matching that term.

params.name: filter_by
params.doc: Parameter defines which result tab to return. It can be set to all (default), videos, photos, or profiles. all mixes profiles, videos, and photos; the other values return only that section.

params.name: next_page_token
params.doc: Parameter defines the token used to retrieve the next page of results. It is returned as pagination.next_page_token when more results are available. A token is issued for a specific q and filter_by, so pass it with the same values.

tiktok_transcripts.name: TikTok Transcripts
tiktok_transcripts.description: Get the transcripts of a TikTok video via API. Timestamped segments, available caption languages, and language selection.

params.name: url
params.doc: Parameter defines the TikTok video you want the transcript for. Pass the full URL, for example https://www.tiktok.com/@stoolpresidente/video/7499229683859426602. Short vm.tiktok.com / vt.tiktok.com / tiktok.com/t/ links are also accepted.Required if video_id and username are not provided.

params.name: video_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the unique identifier of a TikTok video. Use it together with username as an alternative to url.

params.name: username
params.doc: Parameter defines the TikTok creator's username (with or without the @ symbol). Use it together with video_id as an alternative to url. TikTok resolves the post by its video_id: if the username doesn't match the video's owner, TikTok redirects and the actual owner's video is returned.

params.name: language
params.doc: Parameter defines the language of the transcripts. The languages a video offers are returned in available_languages, each entry carrying the track's full code, including the region when TikTok defines one (pt-BR and fr-CA stay distinct). It defaults to the video's original language, and the served track is marked with is_selected. Both 2-letter and 3-letter ISO codes are accepted: an exact code match wins first (en, eng, and eng-US all select English), and a regioned request falls back to its base language when the exact track doesn't exist. Examples: en, es, pt-BR, de, it, ja, ko, zh.

tiktok_video.name: TikTok Video
tiktok_video.description: Get a single TikTok video, photo, or carousel via API. Access the caption, views, likes, comments, shares, music, hashtags, and author details.

params.name: url
params.doc: Parameter defines the TikTok video (or photo or carousel) you want to retrieve. Pass the full URL, for example https://www.tiktok.com/@spidermanmovie/video/7670979152308079885. Photo URLs (/photo/) and short vm.tiktok.com / vt.tiktok.com / tiktok.com/t/ links are also accepted, except short links pointing to photo posts; pass the full /photo/ URL for those.Required if video_id and username are not provided.

params.name: video_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the unique identifier of a TikTok video, photo or carousel. Use it together with username as an alternative to url.

params.name: username
params.doc: Parameter defines the TikTok creator's username (with or without the @ symbol). Use it together with video_id as an alternative to url. TikTok resolves the post by its video_id: if the username doesn't match the video's owner, TikTok redirects and the actual owner's video is returned.

params.name: q
params.doc: Parameter defines the query you want to search. This can be a destination, hotel name, restaurant, attraction, or any travel-related search term.

params.name: tripadvisor_domain
params.doc: This parameter defines the Tripadvisor domain to search on. Each domain corresponds to a specific country/region and language. Check the full list of supported Tripadvisor domains.

params.name: category
params.doc: This parameter filters results by category. Main options are places and forums. Default value is places. You can also filter by place category using: things_to_do, restaurants, destinations, hotels, airlines.

params.name: location
params.doc: Parameter defines the location for the search. The location is resolved to GPS coordinates using the locations API. See the full list of supported locations.

params.name: lat
params.doc: Parameter defines the GPS latitude for the search origin. Must be between -90 and 90. Must be used together with lon.

params.name: lon
params.doc: Parameter defines the GPS longitude for the search origin. Must be between -180 and 180. Must be used together with lat.

params.name: num
params.doc: This parameter defines the number of results to return per page. Acceptable values are between 1 and 100.

params.name: page
params.doc: This parameter defines the page number for pagination. Must be 1 or greater.

tripadvisor_place.name: Tripadvisor Place
tripadvisor_place.description: Get detailed information about a specific Tripadvisor place including hotels, restaurants, attractions, and airlines.

params.name: place_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the Tripadvisor location ID for the place you want to retrieve details for. You can find this ID from a Tripadvisor Search API response in the place_id field.

params.name: tripadvisor_domain
params.doc: This parameter defines the Tripadvisor domain to search on. Each domain corresponds to a specific country/region and language. Check the full list of supported Tripadvisor domains.

tripadvisor_reviews.name: Tripadvisor Reviews
tripadvisor_reviews.description: Retrieve paginated Tripadvisor reviews with ratings, author details, photos, and filtering by rating, language, and sort order.

params.name: place_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the Tripadvisor location ID for the place whose reviews you want to retrieve. You can find this ID from a Tripadvisor Search API response in the place_id field.

params.name: q
params.doc: Full-text search within reviews. Returns reviews whose text mentions the query. Example: madrid.

params.name: translate
params.doc: Controls whether reviews are machine-translated. true (default): reviews from every original language are translated to language.

params.name: language
params.doc: Target language for machine-translated reviews. Only has effect when translate=true (default). Reviews from all languages are translated to this language. Check the full list of supported Tripadvisor languages. Defaults to en.

params.name: original_language
params.doc: Filter reviews by the language(s) they were originally written in. Only has effect when translate=false. Comma-separated values accepted (e.g., en, en,es). Check the full list of supported Tripadvisor languages.

params.name: rating
params.doc: Filter reviews by star rating. Comma-separated values from 1 to 5. Example: 4,5 returns only 4 and 5 star reviews.

params.name: trip_type
params.doc: Filter reviews by travel type. Comma-separated values accepted. Supported values: families, couples, solo, business, friends. Example: families,couples.

params.name: time_of_year
params.doc: Filter reviews by travel period. Comma-separated values accepted. Supported values: jan, feb, mar, apr, may, jun, jul, aug, sep, oct, nov, dec. Filtering by trimester is also supported: mar_may, jun_aug, sep_nov, dec_feb. Example: jan,jun.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Sort order for reviews. Supported values: most_recent, detailed_reviews.

params.name: tripadvisor_domain
params.doc: This parameter defines the Tripadvisor domain to use. Check the full list of supported Tripadvisor domains.

params.name: num
params.doc: Number of reviews per page. Must be between 1 and 20.

params.name: page
params.doc: Page number for results. Each page returns up to num reviews.

walmart_product.name: Walmart Product
walmart_product.description: Access detailed Walmart products data, reviews, prices, and more.

params.name: product_id
params.doc: This parameter specifies the product id. You can use either the product_id or the id field from our Walmart Search API response. The product id can also be found in the URL of the product page. Example: https://www.walmart.com/ip/Snickers-M-M-s-Twix-Fun-Size-Chocolate-Candy-Variety-Pack-Sharing-Size-8-85-oz-Bag/2962332596 where 2962332596 is the product id.

params.name: store_id
params.doc: This parameter pins the response to a specific Walmart store. The prices and availability of a product might be different in each store. You can check the list of stores on Walmart's stores directory. You can download a JSON file with all the store IDs here. When omitted, Walmart localizes the response itself and the store it picked is returned in search_information.store_id; pinning a store is slower, since it needs a fresh browser session to establish.

walmart_reviews.name: Walmart Reviews
walmart_reviews.description: Access detailed Walmart Reviews data in real-time. Retrieve product reviews count, rating, summary, and more in JSON format.

params.name: product_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the Walmart product ID you want to get reviews for.

params.name: rating
params.doc: Filter reviews by rating. Supported values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

params.name: verified_purchases_only
params.doc: Filter to show only verified purchase reviews. Supported values: true, false.

params.name: aspect_id
params.doc: Filter reviews by aspect. You can find the list of aspects in the aspect_stats array in the response. The aspect ID is the id field in the aspect_stats array.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Sort reviews by different criteria. Supported values: relevance Default

params.name: page
params.doc: Parameter defines the page number of results. Must be an integer starting from 1.

walmart_search.name: Walmart Search
walmart_search.description: Access detailed Walmart products data, reviews, prices, and more. Retrieve real-time Walmart search results in JSON format.

params.name: q
params.doc: The parameter specifies your search query. It accepts any term or phrase you'd typically input in a Walmart search.

params.name: category_id
params.doc: This parameter filters search to a specific category id.To find a category id, search on Walmart and add a filter by department, for example: searching for "Bear" and selecting "Food" in Departments gives us https://www.walmart.com/search?q=bear&catId=976759 where976759 is the category ID for "Food". If you also select a sub-category, Walmart links the IDs with an underscore in between, in the same search example we can also select "Candy" as subcategory, giving us https://www.walmart.com/search?q=bear&catId=976759_1096070 where 976759_1096070 is the category id for both "Food" and its sub-category "Candy".

params.name: store_id
params.doc: This parameter pins search results to a specific Walmart store. You can check the list of stores on Walmart's stores directory. You can download a JSON file with all the store IDs here. When omitted, Walmart localizes the response itself and the store it picked is returned in search_information.store_id; pinning a store is slower, since it needs a fresh browser session to establish.

params.name: price_min
params.doc: This parameter controls the minimum price of the products returned. For instance - 10 value would return products with a minimum price of $10.

params.name: price_max
params.doc: This parameter controls the maximum price of the products returned. For instance - 20.5 value would return products with a maximum price of $20.5.

params.name: filters
params.doc: To narrow search results using filters, use the format name:value. For multiple filters, separate them with a double pipe (||). For example: brand:Ghirardelli||retailer_type:Walmart The full list of available filters appears in the response’s filters section. However, the quickest way to discover valid filters is to: Go to Walmart.com.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Parameter allows sorting search results by different criteria. Below is the list of available sorting options: best_match - sort order based on relevance. Default

params.name: page
params.doc: The parameter determines the results page number. It defaults to 1. Walmart stops serving results after page 10, so requests beyond it come back empty even when the response's pagination.other_pages section advertises higher page numbers.

yahoo.name: Yahoo Search
yahoo.description: Scrape Yahoo for organic results, ads, images, videos, knowledge graph and more. Retrieve detailed app data in JSON format.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the terms you want to search on Yahoo. Queries can include operators and advanced filters like "machine learning models", site:, AND, OR, or NOT.

params.name: location
params.doc: This parameter is used to specify the canonical location of the search. For exact targeting or to see all available options, check out the Locations API. If multiple locations match your input, the most popular one will be selected.

params.name: yahoo_domain
params.doc: The default parameter search.yahoo.com defines the Yahoo domain of the search. Check the full list of supported Yahoo Search yahoo_domain domains.

params.name: safe
params.doc: Specifies the filter level for adult content. Available values are: on Default

params.name: time_period
params.doc: Filters results by date. Predefined values are: any_time Default

params.name: allowed_domains
params.doc: Filters results by the domain. You can specify a list of domains separated by a comma, such as bbc.co.uk,spiegel.de. You can also specify top-level domains, such as .io or .com.

params.name: strict_match
params.doc: By default, the value is off, meaning strict matching is disabled, and results from queries that have been auto-corrected for spelling errors are included. To exclude these auto-corrected results, set the value to on.

params.name: page
params.doc: Defines the page index for retrieving search results. Each page contains 7 results.

yandex.name: Yandex Search
yandex.description: Retrieve Yandex search results, including organic results, ads, images, videos, knowledge graph and more. Get detailed app data in JSON format.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the terms you want to search on Yandex. Queries can include operators and advanced filters like "machine learning models".

params.name: location
params.doc: This parameter is used to specify the canonical location of the search. For exact targeting or to see all available options, check the full list of supported Yandex locations.

params.name: yandex_domain
params.doc: The default parameter yandex.com defines the Yandex domain of the search. Check the full list of supported Yandex yandex_domain domains.

params.name: lang
params.doc: Parameter defines the interface language of the search. Check the full list of supported Yandex lang languages.

params.name: time_period
params.doc: This parameter restricts results to URLs based on date. Supported values are: last_day - data from the past 24 hours.

params.name: page
params.doc: Specifies the page of results to return. The default value is 1.

yandex_reverse_image.name: Yandex Reverse Image
yandex_reverse_image.description: Extract visual search data with the Yandex Reverse Image API. Access similar images, image sizes, and related searches in a structured JSON format.

params.name: url
params.doc: Parameter defines the image URL for reverse image search. This is the direct link to the image you want Yandex to analyze. Ensure the URL points to a valid image format (e.g., .jpg, .png, .webp) and is accessible publicly. If the URL contains its own query parameters (e.g., signed CloudFront or S3 links), percent-encode it so they are not mistaken for API parameters.

params.name: crop
params.doc: Crops the image before reverse search. Format: left;top;right;bottom, with each value between 0 and 1. For example, 0.1;0.2;0.6;0.75 selects the region from 10% to 60% of the width and 20% to 75% of the height. Default is 0;0;1;1 (full image). left must be less than right, and top less than bottom. Cannot be used with crop_id.

params.name: crop_id
params.doc: Identifies a pre-defined coordinates within an image for targeted reverse search. This parameter enables searching for a particular section that has been detected and identified by Yandex's image analysis. The crop ID corresponds to a specific area of interest within the image. Cannot be used together with crop.

youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.description: Search and scrape videos, channels, playlists and shorts. Get YouTube data in easy-to-use JSON format.

params.name: q
params.doc: This parameter is used for the terms you want to search on YouTube. Queries can include terms like "cooking tutorials" or "music videos".

params.name: sp
params.doc: The parameter defines filters that can be applied to YouTube search results. For example, the CAI filter restricts the search to videos that were uploaded recently. This parameter is also used when fetching the next page of search results. Replace the current value of the sp parameter with the next_page_token value from the current response in the new search request. This ensures that the filters applied in the initial request are preserved across subsequent pages.

params.name: gl
params.doc: The default parameter us defines the country of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube gl countries.

params.name: hl
params.doc: The default parameter en defines the interface language of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube hl languages.

youtube_channel.name: YouTube Channel
youtube_channel.description: Access detailed information about YouTube channels. Retrieve channel statistics, video lists, and more in a structured JSON format.

params.name: channel_id
params.doc: Identifies the YouTube channel to query. Accepts a channel ID or an '@' handle from YouTube URLs. For channel IDs, use the format: https://www.youtube.com/channel/CHANNEL_ID. For '@' handles, use: https://www.youtube.com/@HANDLE. Examples: UCXZCJLdBC09xxGZ6gcdrc6A for channel IDs; @BostonDynamics for '@' handles.

params.name: gl
params.doc: The default parameter us defines the country of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube gl countries.

params.name: hl
params.doc: The default parameter en defines the interface language of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube hl languages.

youtube_channel_shorts.name: YouTube Channel Shorts
youtube_channel_shorts.description: Retrieve the shorts feed of any YouTube channel. Get channel information and shorts sorted by latest, popular, or oldest in a structured JSON format.

params.name: channel_id
params.doc: Identifies the YouTube channel to query. Accepts a channel ID or an '@' handle from YouTube URLs. For channel IDs, use the format: https://www.youtube.com/channel/CHANNEL_ID. For '@' handles, use: https://www.youtube.com/@HANDLE. Examples: UCWJ2lWNubArHWmf3FIHbfcQ for channel IDs; @NBA for '@' handles.

params.name: gl
params.doc: The default parameter us defines the country of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube gl countries.

params.name: hl
params.doc: The default parameter en defines the interface language of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube hl languages.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Sorts the shorts based on various criteria. The default is latest. Available options are: latest – displays the most recent shorts first.

params.name: next_page_token
params.doc: A token used to retrieve the next page of shorts. Use the pagination.next_page_token from the response to continue pagination.

youtube_channel_videos.name: YouTube Channel Videos
youtube_channel_videos.description: Access detailed information about YouTube channel videos. Retrieve channel information, videos, and more in a structured JSON format.

params.name: channel_id
params.doc: Identifies the YouTube channel to query. Accepts a channel ID or an '@' handle from YouTube URLs. For channel IDs, use the format: https://www.youtube.com/channel/CHANNEL_ID. For '@' handles, use: https://www.youtube.com/@HANDLE. Examples: UCXZCJLdBC09xxGZ6gcdrc6A for channel IDs; @BostonDynamics for '@' handles.

params.name: gl
params.doc: The default parameter us defines the country of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube gl countries.

params.name: hl
params.doc: The default parameter en defines the interface language of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube hl languages.

params.name: next_page_token
params.doc: A token used to retrieve the next page of videos or apply specific filters such as "Popular" or "Oldest". On the first request, the API response includes a pagination.filters array, which provides tokens for different sorting options. The default sorting is "Most Recent". Use the next_page_token for a selected filter to retrieve results for that filter. For subsequent requests within the same filter, use the pagination.next_page_token from the response to continue pagination.Note: Tokens can grow large (8KB+) after several pages. If you encounter 413 or 414 errors, use a POST request with the token in the JSON body instead of the URL query string.

youtube_comments.name: YouTube Comments
youtube_comments.description: Access YouTube comments data including comment text, likes, and more with the YouTube Comments API.

params.name: video_id
params.doc: The unique identifier for a YouTube video. Find it in the video's URL, e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=video_id, or through our YouTube Search API. Also accepts full YouTube URLs (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID) and share links (https://youtu.be/VIDEO_ID).

params.name: gl
params.doc: The default parameter us defines the country of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube gl countries.

params.name: hl
params.doc: The default parameter en defines the interface language of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube hl languages.

params.name: next_page_token
params.doc: This token is used to retrieve the next page of comments or replies. When using the YouTube Comments API, use the next_page_token or replies_next_page_token provided in the previous response to load subsequent pages. For users of the YouTube Video API, comments_sorting_token can also facilitate pagination by fetching additional comment pages. Ensure the appropriate token is used based on the data context and API being accessed.

youtube_post.name: YouTube Post
youtube_post.description: Access YouTube community post data. Retrieve post text, likes, polls, quizzes, images, videos, playlists, and reposts in structured JSON format.

params.name: url
params.doc: The URL of the YouTube community post. Required unless post_id is passed. Accepts post URLs in the format https://www.youtube.com/post/POST_ID and community tab permalinks like https://www.youtube.com/@HANDLE/community?lb=POST_ID or https://www.youtube.com/channel/CHANNEL_ID/community?lb=POST_ID.

params.name: post_id
params.doc: The ID of the YouTube community post, such as UgkxZusu9I1Z-VuU5PGZNA2gclHi8V9CJVZk. Required unless url is passed. Use the id returned by the YouTube Channel Posts API. Cannot be combined with url.

youtube_transcripts.name: YouTube Transcripts
youtube_transcripts.description: Extract YouTube video captions with the YouTube Transcripts Scraper API. Obtain transcript timestamps, durations, and textual content in a JSON format.

params.name: video_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the video_id you want to search. You can find these values in JSON responses in YouTube engine or in YouTube page that appears in URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=video_id. Also accepts full YouTube URLs and share links (https://youtu.be/VIDEO_ID).

params.name: lang
params.doc: The parameter en sets the default language for transcripts. While a variety of languages are supported, often only a few are available. Review the list of known supported YouTube Transcript languages.

params.name: transcript_type
params.doc: Defines the transcript preference when both auto-generated and manually uploaded transcripts are available. auto - Prioritizes YouTube's auto-generated transcript. It can be translated into any lang language, but retrieval may be slower compared to manual transcripts.

params.name: transcript_name
params.doc: Defines the transcript name to retrieve. You can find the available transcript names in the response of the video in the available_languages field. You can use to select the desired transcript by name instead of lang.

params.name: only_available
params.doc: When set to true, enables fallback behavior. The API first attempts to find a transcript matching your lang or transcript_name parameter. If no match is found, it returns the first available transcript instead of an error. Transcripts can still be filtered by transcript_type.

youtube_trends.name: YouTube Trends
youtube_trends.description: Access real-time trending YouTube videos. Retrieve data on video titles, views, channel info, and more.

params.name: bp
params.doc: The parameter specifies the category of trending content. All available options: now - All trending content. (Default)

params.name: gl
params.doc: The default parameter us defines the country of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube gl countries.

params.name: hl
params.doc: The default parameter en defines the interface language of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube hl languages.

youtube_video.name: YouTube Video Details
youtube_video.description: The YouTube Video API offers developers access to YouTube video information. Scrape titles, descriptions, view counts, likes, and more.

params.name: video_id
params.doc: Parameter defines the video_id you want to search. You can find these values in JSON responses in YouTube engine or in YouTube page that appears in URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=video_id. Also accepts full YouTube URLs and share links (https://youtu.be/VIDEO_ID).

params.name: gl
params.doc: The default parameter us defines the country of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube gl countries.

params.name: hl
params.doc: The default parameter en defines the interface language of the search. Check the full list of supported YouTube hl languages.

zillow.name: Zillow
zillow.description: Search Zillow real estate listings. Get property prices, photos, details, and more via API.

params.name: q
params.doc: Location to search for properties. Accepts city/state (e.g., New York, NY), ZIP code (e.g., 10001), or neighborhood name.

params.name: listing_status
params.doc: Type of listing to search. Supported values are: for_sale - Active listings for sale.

params.name: home_type
params.doc: Comma-separated list of property types to include. Supported values are: house, condo, townhouse, multi_family, apartment, land, manufactured. Example: house,condo.

params.name: price_min
params.doc: Minimum listing price for sale and sold listings.

params.name: price_max
params.doc: Maximum listing price for sale and sold listings.

params.name: rent_min
params.doc: Minimum monthly rent for rental listings.

params.name: rent_max
params.doc: Maximum monthly rent for rental listings.

params.name: beds_min
params.doc: Minimum number of bedrooms. Values from 1 to 5.

params.name: baths_min
params.doc: Minimum number of bathrooms. Values from 1 to 4.

params.name: sqft_min
params.doc: Minimum living area in square feet.

params.name: sqft_max
params.doc: Maximum living area in square feet.

params.name: lot_size_min
params.doc: Minimum lot size in square feet.

params.name: lot_size_max
params.doc: Maximum lot size in square feet.

params.name: year_built_min
params.doc: Minimum year built.

params.name: year_built_max
params.doc: Maximum year built.

params.name: parking_spots
params.doc: Minimum number of parking spots.

params.name: keywords
params.doc: Keyword search within listings (e.g., pool, garage).

params.name: has_pool
params.doc: Filter for properties with a pool.

params.name: has_garage
params.doc: Filter for properties with a garage.

params.name: has_ac
params.doc: Filter for properties with air conditioning.

params.name: has_basement
params.doc: Filter for properties with a basement.

params.name: is_waterfront
params.doc: Filter for waterfront properties.

params.name: is_single_story
params.doc: Filter for single-story properties.

params.name: is_3d_home
params.doc: Filter for properties with 3D tours.

params.name: is_open_house
params.doc: Filter for properties with upcoming open houses.

params.name: is_pending
params.doc: Include pending and under contract listings.

params.name: is_new_construction
params.doc: Filter for new construction properties.

params.name: is_coming_soon
params.doc: Include coming soon listings.

params.name: sort_by
params.doc: Sort order for results. Supported values are: relevance, newest, price_asc, price_desc, payment_asc, payment_desc, beds, baths, sqft, lot_size, zestimate_desc, zestimate_asc.

params.name: days_on_zillow
params.doc: Filter by time on Zillow. Supported values are: 1, 7, 14, 30, 90, 6m, 12m, 24m, 36m.

params.name: page
params.doc: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1, maximum is 24.

zillow_property.name: Zillow Property
zillow_property.description: Get detailed property data from Zillow. Pricing, photos, schools, walk scores, comparables, tax history, and more.

params.name: zpid
params.doc: Zillow property ID or full Zillow URL. Accepts a numeric zpid (e.g., 69817587) from Zillow Search API results, or a complete Zillow URL (e.g., https://www.zillow.com/apartments/...) for apartment building pages. Use the link field from search results for buildings.
